purpose: Ingest and no-return screen one issuer reporting-promptness mechanism for the fixed three-session A-share protocol without sweeping disclosure fields, formulas, directions, event ages, dates, prices, or returns.

source_selection.why_this_source: The latest announced financial-report schedule is currently operable and represents an issuer reporting commitment rather than a realized financial result, historical price transform, valuation field, order flow, ownership, analyst opinion, or transaction event.

rejected_same_turn_alternative.reason: Official daily northbound ownership disclosure stopped after 2024-08-20, so the historical signal cannot be reproduced for the current strategy.

mechanism_identity.economic_mechanism: Shorter calendar time between the latest disclosure-plan announcement and the promised report date represents more prompt reporting commitment and is frozen as better.
mechanism_identity.relationship_to_realized_fundamentals: No actual report date, report value, forecast value, profit, revenue, cash flow, ROE, or audit opinion enters the candidate.
mechanism_identity.relationship_to_existing_timing_factors: Survey receipt-to-announcement lag and generic event freshness measure already-observed events. This candidate measures a newly announced forward reporting commitment. A mandatory no-return rank-correlation screen must still reject it if empirical scores are a near synonym.

source.request_mode: one frozen report period per call

point_in_time_and_version_policy.event_date: ann_date, documented by the provider as the latest disclosure announcement date
point_in_time_and_version_policy.planned_date: pre_date, documented by the provider as the expected disclosure date
point_in_time_and_version_policy.actual_date_policy: actual_date is forbidden because it can be unknown at ann_date and is unnecessary for the frozen mechanism
point_in_time_and_version_policy.modify_date_policy: modify_date is requested only to count whether provider revision context exists. Its contents are never parsed as an event date, persisted in the factor frame, ranked, imputed, or used in the formula.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.date_order_policy: ann_date and pre_date must be complete valid calendar dates with ann_date no later than pre_date; any violation aborts the report-period partition
point_in_time_and_version_policy.report_period_policy: end_date must exactly match the requested standard quarter end
point_in_time_and_version_policy.outside_target_code_policy: A complete six-digit .BJ code is excluded and counted before factor construction because BSE is outside factor_main_chinext_star and buyable_main_chinext. Missing, malformed, or any other unknown exchange suffix aborts the partition; no BSE row enters coverage, capacity, ranking, or holdings.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.duplicate_policy: Exact five-field duplicates may be counted and collapsed. Differing rows for one ts_code and end_date abort the partition; never select a convenient version.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.same_instrument_announcement_multi_perio: If full history contains more than one report period for one instrument and ann_date, exclude every colliding event before capacity; never choose the latest, shortest, or largest value.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.conservative_availability: first local trading session strictly after ann_date
point_in_time_and_version_policy.residual_risk: The interface exposes a latest announcement date but no historical intraday release timestamp or complete version stream. Strict next-session availability, conflicting-version rejection, collision exclusion, and immutable retrieval timestamps reduce but cannot eliminate vendor revision-history risk.

factor.name: tushare_disclosure_plan_promptness
factor.economic_direction: a shorter announced lead time is frozen as better
factor.zero_policy: zero is valid when a plan is announced for the same calendar date
factor.absent_event_policy: missing; never treat an absent disclosure-plan row as zero

required_checks_before_full_sync: the environment supplies TUSHARE_TOKEN without logging its value
exactly one disclosure_date request is issued for each frozen report period with only the frozen five fields
each response is below 6000 rows and contains at least 2000 source rows
stock code, latest announcement date, report period, and planned date are complete and valid
complete .BJ rows are excluded and counted while malformed or unknown exchange codes abort acceptance
every returned report period exactly matches its request and every report period is a standard quarter end
latest announcement date is no later than planned disclosure date for every retained row
exact semantic duplicates alone may collapse and conflicting stock-period rows abort acceptance
modify_date presence is counted only and no value enters the factor frame or formula
the local calendar-day difference is an exact nonnegative integer and each period has at least ten distinct values
each period retains at least 1000 rows after strict validation
no actual date, credential, narrative, financial value, price, score, or return appears in a published factor frame or manifest
acceptance_protocol.failed_acceptance_policy: write one no-return rejection record and stop without another period, field relaxation, version selection, full sync, capacity, uniqueness, price access, formula or direction change, score, selection, sizing, orders, or Level-2 justification
acceptance_protocol.one_shot_policy: The exact contract may publish at most one terminal success or rejection record.

full_snapshot_contract.partition_policy: one report-period calendar year per immutable Parquet partition
full_snapshot_contract.failure_cleanup: delete the complete temporary snapshot and publish no final manifest

source_completeness_policy.coverage_denominator: factor_main_chinext_star instruments active on the last local session on or before each report period
source_completeness_policy.failed_gate_policy: stop before event expansion, capacity, uniqueness, or returns; do not fill missing plans, omit weak periods, mix providers, or add actual-date and report-result fields

no_return_capacity_policy.quality_gate: ROE >= 5%, positive net profit, positive revenue YoY, and positive profit YoY, effective only after the next local session following announcement
no_return_capacity_policy.failed_gate_policy: stop without reading returns, changing direction or age, lowering capacity, selecting report periods, or combining a rejected factor

no_return_uniqueness_policy.comparison_scope: every factor in the frozen 43-factor accepted-price frontier plus the terminal Tushare moneyflow, PB, and SW breadth mechanisms where a same-day comparison is defined
no_return_uniqueness_policy.method: On factor-active sessions, rank lower lead days as the frozen higher directional score and compare it with each existing factor inside the same quality/listing-eligible cross-section; compute Spearman correlation and take each comparison's median daily correlation.
no_return_uniqueness_policy.failed_gate_policy: stop without returns, inversion, another lead-time anchor, report-period selection, event-age change, field substitution, or threshold relaxation
